'''Sophanem''', also known as the '''City of the Dead''', is a plague-ridden city located in the southern end of the [[Kharidian Desert]]. In order to gain access, players need to partially progress through [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]]. The city is connected to the capital [[Menaphos]], although it cannot currently be entered.

As its nickname suggests, Sophanem's main business is to take care of the Menaphite deceased, erecting large tombs and pyramids and mainly worshipping [[Icthlarin]], shepherd of the souls of the departed.{{CiteNPC|npc=Sphinx|loc=Icthlarin's Little Helper|quote=Sophanem is called the city of the dead because the dead are brought here. Death plays a rather large role in the beliefs of the people and, as a result, the business.}}{{CiteNPC|npc=Wanderer|loc=Icthlarin's Little Helper|quote=It's the second city of the Menaphites, full of giant monuments to their dead.}} Unfortunately for the Sophanites, these treasure-filled tombs are a magnet for graverobbers such as [[Simon Templeton]]. It is the seat of the High Priest of Icthlarin, whose duties include the protection of the great pyramids and ensuring that the souls of the dead are protected from the [[Amascut]], Icthlarin's deranged sister. [[Cat]]s and their protector, the [[Sphinx]], play an important role in this latter task.{{CiteNPC|npc=Sphinx|loc=Icthlarin's Little Helper|quote=Cats play a significant role in the religion of this area, particularly when it comes to guarding the dead from The Devourer.}}

==Transportation==
[[File:Sophanem entrance.png|thumb|The high walls of Sophanem.]]There are several ways of reaching Sophanem through teleports, listed here in order of least running to most:
*{{Plink|Pharaoh's sceptre}} — [[Pyramid Plunder]] minigame (Jalsavrah).
*{{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|AKP}} — Necropolis island. Requires 62 [[Agility]] and partial completion of [[Beneath Cursed Sands]].
*{{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|DLQ}} — well north of [[Nardah]]. The [[magic carpet]] system can also be used to travel to Sophanem from southern [[Pollnivneach]] after starting [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]]. Players can teleport near a magic carpet, and reach Sophanem:

*{{Plink|Nardah teleport}} — town centre, slightly east of the [[rug merchant]].
*{{Plink|Desert amulet 2|txt=Desert amulets}} — [[Elidinis Statuette|Temple of Elidinis]], slightly east of the [[rug merchant]].

*{{Plink|Construct. cape|txt=Construction cape}} — [[Pollnivneach]] house portal, north of the [[rug merchant]].
===Shortcut===
A shortcut on the wall just east of the bank leads to the camp just north of Sophanem, west of the [[Agility Pyramid]].

==History==
{{LoreSources|Contact!|Beneath Cursed Sands|Icthlarin's Little Helper}}

In the early [[Fifth Age]], Sophanem was beset by a plague, leading many Sophanites to flee to Menaphos and causing the [[High Priest (Sophanem)|new High Priest]] to quarantine upon the city. Menaphos, likewise, was locked down and heavily barricaded. Shortly after, a passing adventurer was hypnotised by the Devourer, who sought the [[Klenter|previous High Priest]]'s soul. The adventurer was able to save the previous High Priest's soul, but the plagues on Sophanem continued. When the plague was found not to be contagious, the city reopened, but the gates of Menaphos remained closed, leaving many citizens of Sophanem trapped within Menaphos. When attempting to lead a delegation to Menaphos to convince them to end the quarantine, the new Head Priest was fired upon by [[Coenus]], head of the Menaphos guards.
[[File:Contact! Menaphos cutscene.png|thumb|Gatekeeper Coenus does not wish to talk with the new High Priest.]]

The aforementioned adventurer was again enlisted by the High Priest and followed a series of Scarabite tunnels under the bank to a chasm underneath Menaphos. Here, the adventurers communicated with [[Maisa]], a spy from [[Al Kharid]], and her deceased colleague [[Kaleef]]. The passage to Menaphos itself was not accessible due to a large chasm, however, leaving her trapped on the other side. Maisa agreed to send word to the Sophanites that they could return if the adventurer would fetch her master, [[Osman]], to help her get out of the quarantined city herself. This was successful, although the Scabarites' [[giant scarab]] guardian, already having killed Kaleef, injured Osman before attacking and being slain by the adventurer. Maisa, who had fled out of the cave on the Menaphite side, kept her word and the townspeople returned home.

During the events of [[Beneath Cursed Sands]], it is revealed that the plagues were caused by [[Amascut]] herself, forcing the [[Sect of Scabaras]] to poison the cows and release plague frogs and locusts upon the city. The pox is revealed to be from the bark of a [[cadavaberry bush]], which is unusual for the area. The source of the pox remains unknown, although it is suggested that [[Osman]] may have been the one to cause it.{{CiteNPC|npc=Osman|loc=Contact!|quote=Maisa? You are mistaken. She's in Menaphos, and that city is locked tight to everyone, thanks in no small part to me.}} Maisa and the player work together to free the [[High Priest of Scabaras]] from the Devourer's control, and with the help of [[Zahur]], developed and distributed a cure for the pox. Additionally, enough citizens have returned to Sophanem that they were able to drive out the frogs and locusts, leaving Sophanem finally free of all the plagues once more. [[Pharaoh Kemesis]], also under the control of Amascut, met with the High Priest of Sophanem, informing him that Menaphos will begin preparations to end the quarantine.

==Notable features==
===Buildings===

* There is a [[Sophanem bank|bank]] in Sophanem for use by anyone who has completed the [[Contact!]] quest. It is located underground beneath the [[Temple of the Lesser Gods]] in the north-east.
* The [[Great Temple]]{{CiteGeneral|url=https://wayback.archive-it.org/all/20090522043236/http://www.runescape.com/kbase/viewarticle.ws?article_id=2702|quote=The Great Temple in the west of the city is home to a number of priests, as well as the High Priest of Icthlarin, who is worth talking to if you are confused about the state of affairs in Sophanem.|title=''RuneScape'' website - Game Guide - Area Guides - Cities and Towns - Sophanem}} is a place of worship overseen by the [[High Priest (Sophanem)|High Priest of Icthlarin]]. It contains an [[Altar (Sophanem)|altar]] to [[Icthlarin]] where one may recharge their [[prayer points]], and several lesser priests.
* The northern pyramid is called Jalsavrah and it is where the ancient [[pharaoh]]s of Sophanem and Menaphos are buried. Players may rob these tombs in the [[Pyramid Plunder]] [[minigame]].
* The southern pyramid, Klenter's pyramid, is the burial site of the Sophanite clergy, named after its most recent occupant rather than carrying a fixed name like its northern twin. It is a principal location during Icthlarin's Little Helper.
* [[Carpenter]]'s home, a large building with an anvil. The [[carpenter]] is involved in the Icthlarin's Little Helper quest.
* [[Stonemason (Sophanem)|Stonemason]]'s home, although nothing is for sale.
* [[Embalmer]]'s home, where players can learn how to enbalm, and also buy as [[pot]]s, [[gnome spice]] and [[antipoison]].

[[File:Menaphos cave.png|thumb|The underground passage to Menaphos.]]
===Marketplace===
[[File:Sophanem market.png|thumb|After the Sophanites return from Menaphos, commerce recommences.]]
A number of stalls open up after the [[Contact!]] quest:
*[[Blades by Urbi]] sells-[[daggers]] from bronze to dragon, and scimitars from bronze to steel.
*[[Jamila's Craft Stall]] sells moulds and other [[crafting]] supplies.
*[[Nathifa's Bake Stall]] sells [[bread]], [[cake]], [[chocolate slice]], and [[waterskin|waterskins]].
*[[Raetul and Co's Cloth Store.|Raetul and Co's Cloth Store]] sells desert clothes and several other Crafting supplies.

=== Sophanem Dungeon ===
The [[Sophanem Dungeon]] is under the bank, and features heavily in the [[Contact!]] quest. It can be extremely dangerous, and requires a light source to traverse. While it takes players under Menaphos, it cannot be used to enter it at this time.
